audience.programmeDescription: Nanobiology is an English-taught joint bachelor from TU Delft and Erasmus University Rotterdam. It combines biology, physics and mathematics to investigate living systems at small scales, with laboratory, computational and imaging work. A minor, electives and a final research project complete the programme.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The external modules and credits are shown, but the conditions for the selected year-three electives still require verification. A full UCR comparison is withheld until a valid pathway is confirmed. Related molecular, computational and biomedical study has been assessed provisionally.
